title: Cold shoot time course 3H/0H Replicate 1
treatment_protocol_ch1: Cold-treatment. The germinated seeds were transferred  to Petri dishes  with 2 layers of No.2 filter paper and  4.5ml of distilled water. They were incubated at 4˚C for the indicated hours.
growth_protocol_ch1: Seven Barley (Hordeum vulgare, cultivar: 'Haruna Nijo') seeds were incubated on 2 layers of No.2 filter paper with 4.5ml disilled water in 9cm Petri dishes at 24˚C for 4 days with 8 hour day length. After that,  the 3 germinated seeds were transferred to other Petri dishes and incubated at 4˚C for indicated hours, then we harvested the shoot and root, separately.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted from the harvested shoot and root from the 3 germinated seeds using Trizol following manufacture's instructions.   The yield and RNA purity were determined spectrophotometrically. Integrity was verified using an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer.
label_protocol_ch1: TotalRNA (400 ng) was labeled with Cy3 or Cy5 using an Agilent Quick Amp Labeling kit .
